evidence_items.title: Checked rstim versus Stim correctness evidence

value.speed_rstim_variants_seed: not applicable to this correctness-only card
value.speed_stim_cli_seed_policy: not applicable to this correctness-only card

evidence_items.claims_limit: Correctness evidence covers eight catalogued small-circuit distributions and the checked d11/r100 full fixture only.
caveats: The distribution evidence covers exactly eight source-grounded cases at the recorded shot count and seed.

The full-fixture correctness summary is statistical evidence on the checked d11/r100 fixture and recorded seed policy; it does not prove all circuits, seeds, detector paths, or simulator features agree with Stim.
The canonical .stim fixture is Stim-generated checked circuit text, not evidence that rstim reproduces Stim generator output.
The showcase is a bounded map of the checked artifacts, not an additional benchmark run.

evidence_items.title: Checked post-optimization release rstim versus Stim selected-case speed evidence

value.speed_stim_cli_seed_policy: Stim CLI speed variant is timed through the recorded perf runner command without a seed-bearing sampler output.
value.speed_seed_scope: The post-optimization release speed artifacts are report-only timing evidence for the recorded selected case and environment, not cross-tool sample stream equivalence.

evidence_items.claims_limit: Checked post-optimization release evidence for one recorded d11/r100 selected-case workload and one recorded environment only; not broad rstim/Stim parity.
caveats: The release evidence is one selected d11/r100 sample workload and one recorded release-profile environment only.
For this recorded release run, rstim-compiled has a higher wall time than stim-cli.
The rstim-vs-Stim timing ratio is report-only context and is not a cross-machine CI gate.
The historical #406 debug-profile artifact remains separate and is not overwritten by this release evidence.
